name: io.github.tinybubbles-app/tinybubbles
title: Tiny Bubbles
description: Task and project automation for local Tiny Bubbles data, with read-only self-hosted Cloud access.

environmentVariables.name: TINYBUBBLES_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the local Tiny Bubbles SQLite database.

environmentVariables.name: TINYBUBBLES_MCP_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted Tiny Bubbles Cloud base URL for read-only Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: TINYBUBBLES_MCP_CLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for read-only self-hosted Tiny Bubbles Cloud mode.
